##### Project general facts

Veranda Collection 2 presents an exclusive boutique townhouse community. Developed under the guidance of Credo Investments, the enclave comprises only thirteen residences. Elegant stone façades and crisp modern lines define its timeless architecture, while each home unfolds across multiple levels and culminates in a private rooftop retreat.

Residents step out onto landscaped gardens and expansive balconies that blur indoor and outdoor living. A private rooftop terrace equipped with a pergola and dedicated BBQ area extends entertainment options. Convenient shaded parking and a premium private elevator service all levels, reinforcing comfort and practicality.

Interiors showcase dramatic double-height living rooms flooded with natural light. Three‑bedroom configurations, balance generous proportions with contemporary warmth. Italian‑crafted kitchens feature quartz countertops, while custom cabinetry and spa‑inspired bathrooms fitted with Italian fixtures elevate the finishing.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle lies strategically between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, linking residents to the entire emirate. The community’s layout places schools, parks, retail venues and dining options within easy reach. Such proximity creates a harmonious blend of urban energy and neighbourhood charm.

Investment fundamentals remain robust, supported by a family‑focused atmosphere. Ongoing new developments and expanding infrastructure drive rising end‑user demand. Landscaped parks, reputable schools, nurseries and everyday conveniences are all within walking distance.

Strategic connectivity ensures a prime Dubai address without sacrificing tranquility. Residents benefit from seamless access to major arteries while enjoying a close‑knit community feel. The area’s reputation for strong investment potential makes it an ideal setting for families to live, invest and grow.
